trigger: Calendar-eligible scheduled close is absent at acquisition deadline
operator_action_allowed: Retry same request; append incident; no signal
evidence_required: request metadata; source response hashes; calendar row

trigger: Expected session remains unavailable past a verified vendor-compatible publication deadline or payload is a wrong-session/duplicate prior-session close
operator_action_allowed: Retry only if deterministic; cannot forward-fill; a mere publication/acquisition delay is not stale
evidence_required: publication/acquisition timestamps; expected and source session keys; raw payload hash

trigger: Next eligible session open is unavailable
operator_action_allowed: Retry same session; no backdated fill
evidence_required: calendar session; source response/error hashes

trigger: Price is null, non-positive, non-finite, or violates OHLC constraints
operator_action_allowed: Rerun validation from immutable bytes only
evidence_required: raw payload; parsed-field error; source request ID

trigger: Immutable ID or unique session/order key repeats
operator_action_allowed: Stop duplicate writer; do not delete either record
evidence_required: duplicate IDs; record hashes; batch manifest

trigger: Authoritative and reconciliation raw fields disagree outside documented adjustment exception
operator_action_allowed: Preserve both; no averaging or silent replacement
evidence_required: both raw payloads; field-level diff; corporate-action evidence

trigger: Disagreement cannot be resolved from immutable evidence
operator_action_allowed: Append incident and stop affected evidence boundary
evidence_required: both raw hashes; escalation record; auditor disposition

trigger: Exchange halt or partial regular session affects required field
operator_action_allowed: Do not invent close/open; wait for calendar/source resolution
evidence_required: exchange alert; source timestamps; raw hashes

trigger: Calendar marks an early close
operator_action_allowed: Use calendar close; no manual time override
evidence_required: calendar version; published schedule evidence

trigger: Calendar-eligible day is unexpectedly closed
operator_action_allowed: Pause and append exchange/calendar evidence
evidence_required: calendar revision; exchange notice; source errors

trigger: Required endpoint unavailable or rate-limited beyond retry policy
operator_action_allowed: Retry within fixed budget; no source substitution
evidence_required: sanitized request; HTTP/error metadata; timestamps

trigger: Split/dividend/distribution factors conflict or are incomplete
operator_action_allowed: Preserve raw values; do not alter adjusted close manually
evidence_required: corporate-action responses; raw hashes; affected sessions

trigger: Required event has naive, invalid, or contradictory timezone
operator_action_allowed: Stop affected path; no session-date inference from Japan time
evidence_required: all timestamp fields; clock health; source metadata

trigger: Vendor changes a value after an observation/decision
operator_action_allowed: Append revision; never overwrite original
evidence_required: original/revised values; old/new hashes; discovery time

trigger: No valid same-timestamp bid/ask or auction proxy
operator_action_allowed: Record NOT_OBSERVABLE_IN_PAPER_MODE; no synthetic proxy
evidence_required: quote/auction request; reason; entitlement status

trigger: UTC clock drift exceeds one-second acceptance tolerance
operator_action_allowed: Restore approved clock; log intervention
evidence_required: clock source; drift measurement; sync result

trigger: Previous/current record or batch hash does not verify
operator_action_allowed: Stop writes; preserve all bytes; escalate
evidence_required: canonical bytes; expected/actual hashes; manifest

trigger: Required authoritative endpoint capability account entitlement or plan semantics are not verified
operator_action_allowed: Hold affected boundary; obtain documented account evidence; no source substitution
evidence_required: sanitized endpoint metadata; plan evidence; capability test

trigger: Vendor publication SLA is unknown so an elapsed grace cannot distinguish publication delay from stale data
operator_action_allowed: Hold expected session; verify vendor-compatible deadline; no signal
evidence_required: publication/acquisition timestamps; vendor SLA evidence

trigger: Pinned dependency package timezone or calendar fixture does not match isolated acceptance environment
operator_action_allowed: Stop all writes; rebuild exact isolated environment
evidence_required: environment manifest; package metadata; fixture output

trigger: Record fails normative shared schema contract or canonical serialization validation
operator_action_allowed: Stop writes; preserve invalid bytes and validator output
evidence_required: schema version; validator output; canonical bytes

trigger: Record references a missing or overwritten immutable parent
operator_action_allowed: Stop writes; preserve parent and child evidence; reconstruct
evidence_required: parent/child IDs; hashes; manifest

trigger: Pinned calendar output differs from predeclared holiday early-close DST or boundary fixture
operator_action_allowed: Do not start or create an official observation; reconcile versioned calendar evidence
evidence_required: calendar version; fixture output; source-page hashes

trigger: Exact source bytes or sanitized request metadata cannot be atomically archived and hashed
operator_action_allowed: Stop before signal; preserve response/error and retry deterministically
evidence_required: raw bytes or error; request metadata; hash output

trigger: The archived raw snapshot cannot reproduce the adjusted-close window used by a decision
operator_action_allowed: Invalidate affected evidence boundary; never substitute a later response
evidence_required: snapshot ID; raw hashes; reconstructed closes; auditor disposition
